in_sanskrit.name: सिमरण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who constantly remembers or recollects

in_marathi.name: Simranraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Remembrance of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Simranraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Simranraj is derived from Sanskrit and Punjabi languages. It consists of two words - Simran meaning remembrance of God and Raj meaning king or rule. This name represents the idea of constantly remembering and being devoted to God, as well as having the power and rule to do so. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl with a spiritual and devotional personality.
